subject: Invoice origination & billing owner assignment — portal primary, email copy
messages:
From: Nora Blake <nora.blake@finserve.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap-team@finserve.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T08:12:00-04:00
Subject: Invoice origin for FinServe - portal vs email?

Hi Priyom,

We're preparing vendor onboarding for Redwood and need to confirm where invoices will originate from and how they'll be delivered. Our preference is portal enrollment (EDelivery) for automation, but AP needs an email copy for the first 60 days while our extraction rules are tuned.

Questions:
- Will Redwood emit invoices from a centralized billing service email (billing@redwoodinference.com) or from customer-specific portal pushes?
- What formats do you support (PDF, UBL/UBL-invoice, XML)?
- We need a VAT registration field, vendor ID, and sample invoice to validate our matching.

I've attached our vendor-onboarding-questionnaire for your team to complete (mostly short answers). Also please confirm any PO matching rules you require so we can surface exceptions programmatically.

Thanks,
Nora Blake
Senior AP Manager, FinServe Technologies
AP Team: ap-team@finserve.com

Attachment: vendor-onboarding-questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Blake <nora.blake@finserve.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T11:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origin for FinServe - portal vs email?

Hi Nora — thanks for the clear notes and the questionnaire. Quick summary up front: we can do portal-as-source (recommended) with an email copy delivered to a CCed address for an agreed transition period.

Details / next steps:
- Origin: In Redwood the canonical emission is from our billing service; for portal-enabled customers we push a signed invoice payload to the portal endpoint you provide. If you opt in to portal, we can also fan out a PDF copy to a designated AP email for the first 60 days.
- Formats: we support PDF (human-readable) and UBL (machine-readable XML). If you need a different schema we can provide a sample UBL2.1 mapping.
- VAT & vendor id: we include a VAT field and a vendor_id metadata tag on every invoice. We'll populate the vendor_id using the value you return in the questionnaire.
- PO matching: default behavior is to match on invoice.PO_number and total amount; we can optionally include line-level matching if you supply PO line references.

Proposed billing owner: Kimberly Park (cc'd) will be the Redwood contact for AP/operations. Kimberly — can you take ownership of the onboarding checklist and share the sample invoice (PDF + UBL) and the DocuSign link for enrollment? Markus — looping you for any SFTP/EDIFACT considerations should FinServe prefer that.

Deliverables from our side within 48 hours once you confirm portal endpoint and preferred format:
- sample-invoice.pdf (human-readable)
- sample-invoice.ubl.xml (UBL sample)
- DocuSign vendor enrollment link (to capture remittance and tax forms)

If portal enrollment is a hard no, we can flip to email-primary with signed PDFs + Attach metadata headers for PO/Invoice numbers; it just means less automation.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: sample-invoice.pdf (stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Blake <nora.blake@finserve.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T13:40:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origin for FinServe - portal vs email?

Hi Nora — happy to take point on this.

A few quick clarifications from AP/ops perspective:
- VAT mapping: we will populate the standard VAT_ID field and include an EU reverse-charge flag where applicable. Please confirm if you need the VAT field in the invoice header AND as a separate metadata tag for your system.
- SFTP option: if FinServe prefers an SFTP ingest in addition to portal, we can drop daily bundles to an endpoint. Markus — can you share the SFTP manifest layout and any filename conventions?
- PO matching: we recommend starting with PO_number+amount and enabling line-item matching for split-POs. If you have an AP rule-set we can map those as part of onboarding.

I'll complete the questionnaire and upload the sample UBL within the next 24 hours. For vetting, I'm attaching our vendor terms and the DocuSign envelope we'll use for signing.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-vendor-terms.pdf (PDF, 112KB)

From: Nora Blake <nora.blake@finserve.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap-team@finserve.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T09:22:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origin for FinServe - portal vs email?

Thanks Priyom/Kimberly — this works for us. We will proceed with portal enrollment but require email copies to ap@finserve.com for the first two months (so we can validate matching). After that window we will flip to portal-only.

Vendor details:
- Vendor ID: FIN-RDWD-7782
- VAT: GB999999973 (UK VAT)

I've attached a signed vendor form and a sample PO for testing. We'll create the portal endpoint and share credentials via our secure onboarding link — please use the DocuSign envelope id below for the remittance agreement.

HubSpot vendor record: HS-23892

Appreciate the support — Nora
